scope: Five visual GNB style proposals only. No code/assets consumed by the app or deployment changes.
fullPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE professional comparison board showing five alternative GNB icon styles for CREFANS. This is one design decision sheet, not production assets.
Reference image 1 role: current production mobile UI context; retain white UI, blue accent, soft rounded active tile, icon-only bottom navigation, red number badges, five equal positions.
Reference image 2 role: existing rounded flat category icon family. Style01 should harmonize closely with these bright simple filled illustrations. Do not copy its category subjects.
Canvas: 1536x2048 portrait, sharp clean Korean typography and very generous whitespace. Entire board fully contained, no cropping.
Title exactly: "GNB 아이콘 스타일 5안".
Small subtitle exactly: "홈 · 탐색 · 메시지 · 알림 · 마이".
Create EXACTLY FIVE clearly separated horizontal sections, equal heights and identical comparison layout.
Section headings exactly:
"01 라운드 플랫"
"02 볼드 라인"
"03 소프트 듀오톤"
"04 브랜드 그라데이션"
"05 미니 클레이"
Each section contains:
A. An enlarged preview of EXACTLY FIVE icons aligned on an invisible five-column grid: simple house, magnifying glass, SINGLE rounded comment speech bubble with a tail and EMPTY interior, bell, generic user head-and-shoulders silhouette. Never envelope, paper plane, doubled bubbles, compass, heart or text lines in message icon.
B. Immediately below, a compact realistic mobile bottom navigation strip on white, five equal 48x48 touch slots using THE SAME FIVE icon designs at 28px-like optical size. No text labels inside the strip. Home is active on a pale blue rounded rectangular tile; others are muted. A tiny red circular badge with white "2" on message and "5" on bell. Last slot uses the same generic user icon as a no-photo fallback, never invent a person's photo. No changes to the order between sections. No device frame or phone mockup.
Styles:
01: Round FLAT filled geometry, slightly plump rounded corners, mostly saturated CREFANS blue #2563eb with discreet lavender secondary shapes. Flat, no shadows, clean small-size silhouettes. Consistent with reference 2.
02: BOLD rounded monoline icons, uniform strong stroke, all interiors white/empty, rounded caps and joins, royal blue active and slate gray inactive. No 3D or extra decoration.
03: SOFT DUOTONE, clean blue contour plus pale periwinkle filled interior panels, two flat colors, crisp rounded geometry. No gradients, shadows, or volume.
04: BRAND GRADIENT, simple solid silhouettes with a restrained smooth pink to purple to blue gradient, flat front-on design, NO shiny glass or 3D. Keep tiny nav silhouettes easy to identify.
05: MINI CLAY, subtly dimensional matte soft blue/lilac molded shapes, shallow volume only, gentle lighting, no excessive details, recognizably different from all flat rows.
Style comparisons should be visually DISTINCT yet all appropriate to a calm modern creator platform. Maintain identical icon subjects, optical size, spacing, canvas layout, selected state and unread counts for fair comparison. Use correct readable Korean headings. No extra claims, slogans, stars, watermarks, decorative UI, giant gradients, or background texture. White background.
This is a visual preview only, not an actual implemented UI.

checks: Five labeled sections and five icon subjects in the same order
25 enlarged icon examples and five icon-only GNB strips
Home active tile and red numeric message2/notification5 badges
Readable Korean headings and no cropped rows
Current profile photo unchanged: generic user is a fallback concept only
observations: Some subtle gradients/volume remain in style03 and inactive colors in03/04/05 are not completely normalized. This is a style selection concept, not finalized UI states.
notVerified: Exact28px raster readability and44px touch targets

recommendation.alternative: 02 볼드 라인: 단순하고 선명한 메뉴 형태
